title_original: Studio Voltaire: Open Call for Artists from the Democratic Republic of the Congo

blocks.text: A fully funded London residency offers Congolese artists the opportunity to develop their practice, conduct independent research, and build international artistic connections.

Studio Voltaire, one of London’s independent non-profit arts organisations, invites applications from emerging visual artists from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) for a twelve-week residency. Supported by the Defise Foundation, the programme encourages artistic experimentation, cultural exchange and professional development across a range of visual arts disciplines.

The selected artist will receive a private residential studio, a living allowance of £2,400, funding for research, materials and production, and full coverage of travel and visa expenses. Curatorial support, mentorship, and access to London’s wider artistic community are integral to the programme, culminating in opportunities to share work through open studio events and public engagement.

Applications are particularly encouraged from artists who have not previously undertaken a residency outside Africa, to help address financial and logistical barriers to international artistic mobility. Studio Voltaire+1
The residency takes place at Studio Voltaire in London, United Kingdom, from 1 April to 27 June 2027.
